# awscc_elasticache_snapshot (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::ElastiCache::Snapshot



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN (Amazon Resource Name) of the snapshot.
- `auto_minor_version_upgrade` (Boolean) If true, opt-in to the next auto minor version upgrade campaign.
- `automatic_failover` (String) Indicates the status of automatic failover for the source replication group.
- `cache_cluster_create_time` (String) The date and time when the source cluster was created.
- `cache_cluster_id` (String) The identifier of an existing cluster to create a snapshot from. The snapshot is created from this cluster.
- `cache_node_type` (String) The name of the compute and memory capacity node type for the source cluster.
- `cache_parameter_group_name` (String) The cache parameter group that is associated with the source cluster.
- `cache_subnet_group_name` (String) The name of the cache subnet group associated with the source cluster.
- `data_tiering` (String) Enables data tiering. Data tiering is only supported for replication groups using the r6gd node type.
- `engine` (String) The name of the cache engine used by the source cluster.
- `engine_version` (String) The version of the cache engine version used by the source cluster.
- `kms_key_id` (String) The ID of the KMS key used to encrypt the snapshot.
- `node_snapshots` (Attributes List) A list of the cache nodes in the source cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_snapshots))
- `num_cache_nodes` (Number) The number of cache nodes in the source cluster.
- `num_node_groups` (Number) The number of node groups (shards) in this snapshot.
- `port` (Number) The port number used by each cache nodes in the source cluster.
- `preferred_availability_zone` (String) The name of the Availability Zone in which the source cluster is located.
- `preferred_maintenance_window` (String) Specifies the weekly time range during which maintenance on the cluster is performed.
- `replication_group_description` (String) A description of the source replication group.
- `replication_group_id` (String) The identifier of an existing replication group to create a snapshot from. The snapshot is created from this replication group.
- `snapshot_name` (String) The name of a snapshot. Must be unique within the customer account.
- `snapshot_retention_limit` (Number) For an automatic snapshot, the number of days for which ElastiCache retains the snapshot before deleting it.
- `snapshot_source` (String) Indicates whether the snapshot is from an automatic backup (automated) or was created manually (manual).
- `snapshot_status` (String) The status of the snapshot. Valid values: creating | available | restoring | copying | deleting | failed | deleted.
- `snapshot_window` (String) The daily time range during which ElastiCache takes daily snapshots of the source cluster.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) A list of tags to be added to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `topic_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the topic used by the source cluster for publishing notifications.
- `vpc_id` (String) The Amazon Virtual Private Cloud identifier (VPC ID) of the cache subnet group for the source cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--node_snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `cache_cluster_id` (String) A unique identifier for the source cluster.
- `cache_node_create_time` (String) The date and time when the cache node was created in the source cluster.
- `cache_node_id` (String) The cache node identifier for the node in the source cluster.
- `cache_size` (String) The size of the cache on the source cache node.
- `node_group_id` (String) A unique identifier for the source node group (shard).
- `snapshot_create_time` (String) The date and time when the source node's metadata and cache data set was obtained for the snapshot.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
